# Law Offices of Theodore A. Naima, P.C.

> A New York personal injury law firm specializing in medical malpractice, wrongful death, and accident claims across Long Island and Florida.

Theodore A. Naima is an accomplished trial attorney recognized by Martindale-Hubbell with AV Preeminent ratings and New York Law Journal Verdict Hall of Fame honors. The firm serves clients throughout Long Island, New York, and Florida with expertise in complex personal injury litigation.
